prompt: Create an orthographic stair correction atlas with exactly THREE columns and TWO rows on transparent background. Columns left to right: FRONT, TOP, REAR. Row 1 is the UP churned-earth battlefield stair in first reference; row 2 is the DOWN stair in second reference, preserving each source direction. Match dark brown timber structure, rough packed earth, small grass/moss patches and capped posts. FRONT is level straight-on riser elevation, showing vertical riser faces as horizontal bands, not a looking-down flight. TOP is true overhead plan showing horizontal tread/earth surfaces in sequence and only small post-cap footprints; no upright post shafts or full riser/front face. REAR is opposite structural backing elevation, opaque wood/earth support with no forward treads. Strict orthographic, no perspective/isometric. One centered complete projection per row-cell with transparent gutters, no labels/borders/scenery/cast shadows, no clipping or additional props.
normalization_policy: FRONT and REAR share a uniform scale derived from current accepted elevation Z, capped at width252px to retain a 2px transparent margin; TOP uniformly fits the current TOP bbox. Candidate source dimensions and scale are per-view.
